question:
You are helping Rachid, who runs a manufacturing company near Casablanca. Here is what they told you, in their own order.
The company is choosing among 5 improvement projects, labelled P1 to P5.
The parking lot has 24 spaces, 5 of them reserved for visitors.
Each project is either done in full or not at all. Cost and expected yearly benefit:

| Project | Cost (dollars) | Yearly benefit (dollars) |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | 71,000 | 74,000 |
| P2 | 65,000 | 118,000 |
| P3 | 35,000 | 61,000 |
| P4 | 66,000 | 88,000 |
| P5 | 85,000 | 139,000 |

The total budget is 142,000 dollars.
The annual safety inspection last took place 6 months ago and found no issues.
The site's internet subscription costs 139 dollars per month.
Last year's total revenue was 2,900,000 dollars.
Which projects should be funded to maximise the total yearly benefit?
answer_keys: The maximum total yearly benefit in dollars
objective_key: The maximum total yearly benefit in dollars
